title: CSS Subgrid
summary: Let a nested grid line up with the tracks of its parent grid.

subtopics.title: Parent grid tracks
subtopics.explanation: A grid container defines row and column tracks that its children can use. With ordinary nested grids, each child grid calculates its own tracks, so columns may not line up across separate cards. Subgrid lets a child reuse selected tracks from its parent.

subtopics.title: Inherit tracks with subgrid
subtopics.explanation: A subgrid lets a nested grid inherit row or column tracks from its parent grid. For example, cards in one row can align their titles and actions even when their text lengths differ. The child must participate in the parent’s grid placement for the shared tracks to line up.

subtopics.title: Choose rows, columns, or both
subtopics.explanation: Set `grid-template-columns: subgrid` or `grid-template-rows: subgrid` on the child to inherit that axis. You can inherit one axis while defining the other locally. This is useful when a card needs shared columns but an independent internal row layout.

subtopics.title: Reduce duplicated alignment rules
subtopics.explanation: Because related children share the parent’s tracks, you do not have to repeat guessed widths in each nested grid. This keeps alignment consistent as content changes. Use subgrid when the shared relationship is real; a standalone grid is simpler when the child layout is independent.

subtopics.title: Verify browser support and fallback
subtopics.explanation: Check subgrid support in the browsers used by your audience. If a browser lacks it, nested content should still have a readable layout using normal grid or block flow. Test long text and zoomed layouts, not only the short sample content.

foundations.overview: Subgrid lets a grid item use its parent grid’s row or column tracks. This helps separate child markup align with shared columns or rows without repeating track sizes. Use it when alignment matters across nested components.
foundations.mentalModel: It is like smaller teams using the same floor plan as the whole office.
foundations.whyItMatters: It keeps complex layouts aligned as content changes.

keyTakeaways: A grid container defines rows and columns.
A subgrid inherits selected tracks from its parent.
Subgrid supports rows, columns, or both.
Check support for the browsers you need.
